items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I went back to Archie with the band.

ctx.x: When did you go to Columbia?

items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: he started a band and I got to play in it

ctx.x: Yes; he also had a correspondence course and I took that and got to know him. In '31--I think it was '31, he started a band and I got to play in it, this was over in Westchester somewhere. Fletcher Henderson at that time had gone down the street--there were bands all over the Post Road in those days. I got to know Fletcher later in Benny's band.
